mapper.insert: INSERT INTO room (room_id, source, creator_id, last_seq, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{source}, #{creatorId}, #{lastSeq}, NOW(), NOW())
INSERT INTO user_pair_room (user_min, user_max, room_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userMin}, #{userMax}, #{roomId}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE room SET last_seq = last_seq + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
mapper.select: SELECT ur.room_id AS roomId, ur.last_msg_time, ur.read_seq AS readSeq FROM user_room ur WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.hidden_at IS NULL ORDER BY ur.last_msg_time DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM room r WHERE r.room_id IN #{roomId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_room WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND hidden_at IS NULL

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (msg_id, room_id, seq, from_user_id, msg_type, content, client_msg_id, ref_type, ref_id, state, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{msgId}, #{roomId}, #{seq}, #{fromUserId}, #{msgType}, #{content}, #{clientMsgId}, #{refType}, #{refId}, #{state}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE message SET state = 'RECALLED', recalled_at = NOW(), recalled_by = #{recalledBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND seq = #{seq} AND state = 'NORMAL'
